test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 20 June of a particular year falls on the 6th day after Tuesday, then what will be the day on 11 August of the same year?
solution:
6th day after Tuesday is Monday.

20 June → Monday

Number of days between 20 June to 11 August = (10 + 31 + 11) = 52

52 when divided by 7, leaves 3 as remainder.

Monday + 3 = Thursday

So, the day on 11 August of the same year will be Thursday.

Hence, ‘**Thursday**’ is the correct answer.
